title: 距離測定用の歩行輪
description: 歩道・外構の距離測定場面に置く手押し測定輪。開いたスポーク、ゴム輪、フォーク、折り畳みロック風の継手、計数器外装、グリップと自立スタンドを造形。数字・距離スケール、回転・折り畳み・計測機能はなく、校正値や測定精度を示すものではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.226 × 1.234 × 0.699 m、6,596三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A push-along measuring-wheel prop for sidewalk and landscape layout scenes, with open spokes, rubber tire, fork, folding-lock exterior, counter housing, grip and parking stand. No digits, distance scale, wheel rotation, folding or measuring behavior is included; this does not represent calibrated measurement accuracy. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.226 × 1.234 × 0.699 m; 6,596 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
